purpose: Teach: 希少/翻弄/養殖/押し寄せ/異変/地質/学説/真偽

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、希少疾患の患者さん、本気で、研究、本当に、進めてまいります、絶対、患者さんの未来のため、本気で。
lines.en: Ren, I'm committed to advancing research for rare-disease patients. Truly committed. For their future.
lines.style: Steady, measured commitment. Unhurried. A doctor speaking from years of small, deliberate choices. Direct eye contact. The weight of responsibility in the pacing, not the volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病に翻弄される患者さん、本当に、医師として、心が、痛む、思いですよね、先生、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対。
lines.en: As a doctor, it really does weigh on me—patients suffering at the mercy of disease. I'm truly grateful for you, sensei.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. Not performing emotion but letting it surface naturally. A moment of quiet recognition of shared burden. Then the gratitude lands clean, without fanfare.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。養殖魚の感染症研究、医療にも、本気で、応用、できる可能性、ありますね、絶対、本気で、面白い、時代です。
lines.en: Yes. Infectious disease research in aquaculture—there's real potential to apply it to medicine. It's a fascinating time we're in.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Leaning forward slightly into the idea. Speaking as someone who sees the connections others miss. Energized but contained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: パンデミック時、患者、本気で、押し寄せた状況、先生、本気で、大変でしたよね、絶対、本当に、感謝、しないと、本気。
lines.en: During the pandemic, when patients were overwhelming the system... you must have been under enormous strain. I really should thank you more.
lines.style: Quiet reflection with an undertone of awe. A young person recognizing what someone older actually carried. Not flattering—genuinely struck by it. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの症状、本気で、異変、見逃さないよう、心がけております、絶対、本当に、責任、感じております、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. I make sure never to miss even subtle changes in my patients' symptoms. I feel the responsibility of that deeply.
lines.style: Precise, careful. Each word deliberately chosen. Someone describing the invisible discipline of attention. Calm but not cold—this is how care sounds when it's woven into daily practice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学と地質学、本気で、繋がる時代、なってきましたね、先生、絶対、面白い、研究、進んでますよね、本当に、本気で。
lines.en: Medicine and geology are converging now—it's remarkable. Your research is really moving forward, isn't it?
lines.style: Bright with genuine curiosity. Not flattery but real interest in the frontier where disciplines meet. Leaning in. The inflection at the end is wonder, not question-mark.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。最新の学説、本気で、医療現場、絶対、活用してまいります、本気で、患者さんの、未来のため、本当に、頑張ります、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'm committed to bringing the latest research into clinical practice. For my patients' futures, I'll keep pushing forward.
lines.style: Grounded determination. Not grandiose. Speaking of concrete daily work—implementing new knowledge, staying current. The tone is quiet resolve: I show up and do this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療情報の真偽、本気で、見極める力、市民にも、本気で、求められる時代、ですね、先生、本気で、絶対、深刻な、課題。
lines.en: In this era, people need to develop the critical eye to judge what's true in medical information. It's become urgent, hasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful concern without alarm. A young person naming something he's noticed. Slower pace. Genuine—not rehearsed. The closing feels like he's thinking aloud with someone he trusts.
